name: com.getskinbliss/skin-bliss
title: Skin Bliss
description: Look up skincare products: what the formula offers, which skin it suits, what to watch out for.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the Skin Bliss skincare catalog by product name or brand, or by need: category, skin type, a skin concern the formula targets, ingredients to avoid, formula strengths such as barrier support or hydration, and brand type. Returns up to 5 products with what they suit, what their formula offers, and what to watch out for: the best matches, not every match. Use get_product for one product's details. Not for identifying a rash, symptom or skin condition, or for choosing a treatment.

category.description: Product type; actives = serums and treatments, makeup = foundation, BB and CC cream, concealer, other = deodorant, shaving, perfume, sanitizer, nail and oral care

skin_type.description: Products that suit this skin type better than most of their kind

concern.description: A concern the product has a Skin Bliss claim for: very_dry_skin, redness, sensitive_skin, fine_lines, wrinkles, dullness_texture (dull or rough skin), dark_spots (dark spots, post-acne marks), acne (breakouts), blackheads (and clogged pores), oil_pores (oiliness, visible pores), acne_prone (no ingredients rated pore-clogging), eczema_prone, rosacea_prone. For the other concerns, products that can make it worse are left out; the three -prone ones are fit claims (no common triggers, barrier support, no pore-clogging ingredients). Rinse-off products (cleansers, clay and cleansing masks, scrubs) have no concern claims

free_from.description: Ingredients the product must not contain; essential_allergens = strong allergens

formula.description: What the formula must offer at a real dose: barrier_support, barrier_lipids (ceramides, cholesterol), sealing (occlusives), hydration, soothing, antioxidants, brightening, ferments, peptides, retinoid, aha, bha (salicylic acid), pha, oil_control, gentle_cleansing (cleansers that won't strip skin)

brand_category.description: Brand type and price level: drugstore (budget), masstige (mid-price), prestige, luxury, pharmacy (dermocosmetics), professional (clinic), indie, natural (brands positioned as natural or organic), k_beauty, j_beauty, suncare

cruelty_free.description: Only brands known to be cruelty-free

age_group.description: Leaves out the ingredients the Skin Bliss app avoids for this age: 16_to_19 (retinoids, AHAs, vitamin C, tea tree and similar), 12_to_15 (also PHAs, peptides, vitamin C derivatives, zinc gluconate), 11_or_under (also BHA, benzoyl peroxide, sulfur and azelaic acid)

for_men.description: Only lines marketed for men. Without it, men's lines are left out unless the query names men, shaving or beards

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get one Skin Bliss catalog product by the ref from search_products: what it suits and targets, its formula strengths, key ingredients, ingredient flags, things to watch out for and brand notes. Not for identifying a rash, symptom or skin condition, or for choosing a treatment.
